cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Warmly Enforced
cards.instruction: Remain kind and welcoming while enforcing increasingly restrictive rules without exception.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We're so glad you're staying. The guest bed is yours; just no food upstairs. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. I'll have my breakfast downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Lovely. After nine, please; we keep the kitchen quiet before then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train's at eight. Could I take a banana?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd love you to have one. Breakfast food stays in the kitchen, though. Can you catch a later train?

mechanism: A warmly hosts a guest, retains every breakfast restriction and offers travel planning to keep the guest participating.
confusable: Unlike granting a kindness exception, A adjusts the guest arrangements around unchanged rules.
comparison: Guest train and breakfast restrictions differ from observing a swim induction.
seedUse: D189-a banana, kitchen and train; S02-a looks for a later train rather than waive breakfast rules.
